findings.consequence: When a factory-page request gets a 403 after the account catalog was read, this replaces that repository's cache with denied/empty and clears evidence, but does not render. The prior issue titles and source links remain on screen until every sibling repository read settles (Promise.all at lines 153–157); a slow or hung sibling therefore prolongs displaying data after authority denial.
findings.minimalfix: After applying the denied state, render immediately (and update status as appropriate); add a browser regression where one repository returns 403 while another response is held, asserting the denied repository's issue/evidence disappears before releasing the held response.

dimensions.name: Configured-repository scope and read-only behavior
dimensions.rationale: Repository configuration bounds catalog access; branch mappings and labels do not grant access. Discovery uses GETs and the board does not mutate issue state.

dimensions.name: Fresh issue/app authority
dimensions.rationale: RepositoryAccess rechecks connected-user and installation grants. The inherited #50 known issue-read-grant loss correction classifies it as denied and has a recorded regression; this does not close #50 or establish connected-user acceptance.

dimensions.name: SourceRequestGuard initiation and connection generation
dimensions.rationale: Requests initiate under the session lock and guard stopped token, session reference, connection reference, and generation; handlers recheck liveness around reads and projections.

dimensions.name: Source/API and browser bounds, PR exclusion, and coverage
dimensions.rationale: Issue pages are capped at 25 records and 10 pages, response and retained-browser sizes are bounded, PRs are excluded while raw records count toward coverage, and incomplete reads are not presented as empty.

dimensions.name: Collected-title search and direct exact-number lookup
dimensions.rationale: The contract explicitly limits title search to collected pages and directly requests exact numbers across selected configured repositories. No exhaustive index or new command policy is required.

dimensions.name: Default-branch metadata separation
dimensions.rationale: Configured and observed default branches are projected separately; conflicts and missing metadata do not infer registration or permission.

dimensions.name: Source identity, async reads, pruning, and clearing
dimensions.rationale: Data scope and epochs isolate replacement identities. The corrected catalog contraction prunes removed repositories/evidence and redraws before slower remaining reads, with unread placeholders. However, a 403 from a factory page clears its repository cache without redrawing until sibling requests settle (finding above).

dimensions.name: URL state and shared list/board predicate
dimensions.rationale: View and filter state is URL-backed, both presentations use the same matches predicate, and issue destinations and explicit paging are retained.

dimensions.name: Historical evidence versus current stage/lease authority
dimensions.rationale: Explicitly read, validated associated reports/runs are historical evidence; unread or unavailable facts remain unknown, with no inference of current lease, eligibility, or absent work.

dimensions.name: Safe inert rendering, keyboard/narrow layouts, navigation, and assets
dimensions.rationale: Source text is rendered through textContent, links are constructed for GitHub, semantic controls/navigation and responsive styles exist, and browser fixtures cover keyboard and 390px layouts. Physical-phone proof remains owner-deferred, not established.

dimensions.name: Verification and remaining acceptance/CI/judgement gates
dimensions.rationale: The supplied checkpoint records two-CPU full verification of 39 Node, 121 web, 38 runtime, and 30 browser tests, plus the catalog-contraction regression. I did not execute verification. Prior unbounded CLR startup failures are not green evidence. Exact-head hosted CI, actual connected-user issue/discovery acceptance, active reservation coverage, prerequisite #50 acceptance/final judgement, and final Done remain open; no physical-phone proof is claimed.

correction: Centralized repository denial clears only that repository and its evidence and redraws immediately, including page and evidence read failures. It does not wait for a slow sibling read. Global session loss now offers account recovery and never labels missing authority an empty backlog.

red.test: a denied page removes old titles before a slow sibling response settles

green.command: npm run verify with two-CPU affinity

remaining: Current-head CI, independent correction checkpoint and actual connected-user acceptance remain open; no Done or phone proof is claimed.
